description: Video to GIF. Build a GIF from a fragment. The palette is generated for your specific video in a separate pass — without that you get noise instead of a picture. Accepts video/*, .mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .avi, .m4v; up to 500 MB per file.

fps.description: Frames per second. More is smoother and heavier

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: video_to-gif
